name: Never flow analysis requires static branch typing

input.fixture_ref: Use a raising Never branch in an if, exhaustive match, and definite-return analysis.

applicability.reason: Requires static branch typing, confirmed by measurement. C083 makes exhaustive match, definite return, definite assignment, typed catch and branch RESULT analysis treat Never as bottom, so a branch that can only raise contributes no value Type. Every one of those is a static obligation. Probing confirms the runtime cannot distinguish: `if true { 1 } else { raise :boom }` answers 1 and the raising branch answers its raise, which is correct execution and says nothing about whether the branch contributed a Type to the enclosing expression. The analyser tracks no expression Types, so there is nothing for Never to be bottom OF yet. Same subsystem as CONTROL-V937 and TYPES-V208.

expect.status: Never branches contribute no result Type and satisfy the corresponding flow analysis obligations.
